maria-support: FYI — Kepler AI (org kepler-88) says their assistant answers got noticeably shorter / less elaborative after our v3.3 rollout last night. They provided before/after snippets and token counts. Can we triage quickly? They asked for a pin back to the previous model if this is a regression. :eyes:

kevin-cs: Can you paste the exact request payload + the two sample responses (before/after)? Also need model name + rollout timestamp and whether customer is on Hosted or Dedicated.

maria-support: Paste below. Hosted customer. Rollout: redwood-instruct-v3.3 -> promoted to hosted at 2026-03-15T22:10:12Z (commit a9c3f8). Payload they used:```json
{
  "model": "redwood-instruct-v3.3",
  "prompt": "You are a customer support assistant. Provide helpful steps to reset a password.",
  "max_tokens": 150,
  "temperature": 0.0,
  "stop": ["\n\n"]
}```

Customer-provided examples: Before (v3.2, 2026-03-14):
"""
Sure — to reset your password, go to Settings > Security, click "Reset password", follow the email link, and choose a strong password. If you don't get the email check spam and then contact support@kepler.ai with your account ID.
"""
Tokens: 48

After (v3.3, 2026-03-16):
"""
Reset your password via Settings > Security -> Reset password. Check spam or contact support.
"""
Tokens: 18

maria-support: Customer says this pattern repeats across prompts (less elaboration, fewer clarifying suggestions). They depend on those extra sentences for compliance and tone. They've asked for a temporary pin to v3.2 or a rollback while we investigate.

sanjay-ml: Thanks — initial thoughts: could be a change in the system prompt/instruction tuning or a decoding default (e.g., altered logit bias, top_p/beta scheduling, or truncation behavior if stop sequence handling changed). Also check if we altered any post-processing that prunes short sentences.

Can you confirm whether prompt templates or instruction amplification in the model spec were updated between v3.2 and v3.3? If not, I'll run a quick automatic A/B with a 50-sample prompt set and compute avg token length, avg sentence count, and a brevity score (we have the eval harness).

lisa-eng: Runtime note: no elevated errors or latency for that rollout window. However, release notes for a9c3f8 mention an attention-kernel optimization and a small change to the prefix/KV cache eviction heuristics. Neither should intentionally shorten output but could change decoding state enough to affect generation boundary behavior.

I can pin kepler-88 to v3.2 immediately if we decide. Need an explicit go from product/support. Also will diff the commit and run the synthetic compare Sanjay requested. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Deployment event: redwood-instruct-v3.3 promoted to hosted at 2026-03-15T22:10:12Z (commit a9c3f8). Canary=10%, Region=us-west-2.

kevin-cs: For triage — Maria, please ask customer for 3 short example prompts that exercise the behavior (they said it's across intents). Put them in a single thread reply and include conversation IDs if available. I'll ask Customer Success to offer a pin as an interim mitigation.

maria-support: Sent request to Kepler and they responded with 3 prompts (copied below). They also gave a conversation id: conv_kepler_4492. Prompts: 1) "Help me write a polite password reset instruction for non-technical users." 2) "Explain why a password policy requires complexity, in plain language." 3) "List troubleshooting steps if a reset email doesn't arrive."

kevin-cs: Product is OK with temporary pin; please proceed to pin kepler-88 to redwood-instruct-v3.2 and notify the customer. Also include a short note: "We're investigating a subtle change in answer length and tone after a model update. We pinned you to the prior model while we analyze."

sanjay-ml: I'll start the automated eval now using the 3 prompts + our standard 50 prompt set. Will post delta metrics (avg tokens, avg sentence count, lexical entropy) in ~30m. If we see a consistent drop in tokens/entropy we treat as model-behavior regression rather than prompt-side issue.

lisa-eng: Pin workflow started for org kepler-88 -> pinned to redwood-instruct-v3.2 (request #PR-4521). ETA to complete: ~6 minutes. I'll also kick off a kernel-diff check between a9c3f8 and the previous tag and attach results. :mechanical_arm:

maria-support: Thanks team — I'll confirm to Kepler once pin is active. Please keep me posted on the eval numbers; customer cares about the additional clarifying sentences we used to include. :thinking_face:
